steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Sir, have some water.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: You haven't had so much as a sip since yesterday. You still have a hunt later. This is too...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: No need.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: But––

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: This is my decision.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Don't make me say this twice, Matterhorn.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Give it up, Matterhorn.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: You know better than anyone how stubborn Sir Enciodes is. You knew he wouldn't accept, so why ask?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: I must at least try.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: This is too... risky.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Risk and opportunity are two sides of the same coin. It's always been this way for us.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: All we have to do is listen to him.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: It's cold. The snowstorm is getting stronger, isn't it?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: He's taking too long.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: What a showy guy he must be to have the two other clans wait for him?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: He's walking all the way here. That's not so bad, if you ask me.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: What a surprise. You are commending him? From what I heard, Enciodes is enjoying quite the celebrity status on his way here.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Arctosz, you'd best be careful. Give it a few more days and Kjeragandr's most devout follower will be Enciodes instead of you.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Enough of your jabs, Ratatos.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I don't trust Enciodes, but if he does right thing, who am I to argue?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Now if you brought me here just to say this, you'll have to excuse me.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I don't have so much free time on my hands, Arctosz.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I just wanted to remind you.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Remind me? There's nothing I need you, of all people, to remind me of.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Are you sure about that?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Arctosz, bickering at each other isn't going to help either of us. Given the circumstances, our families have the strongest ties.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I'm not the one who's bickering, Ratatos.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I don't like how you and Enciodes are always beating around the bush. I care about actions and nothing else.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You care about actions. Perfect, then.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Let's talk about the explosion two days ago.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: What? Are you going to tell me that was the Browntails' doing? Hmph, I'm not falling for that. That's not your style.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Or are you trying to say you know who's behind it?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: What if I tell you I really do...?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: —You're not kidding?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Definitely not.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Why don't you take a guess who gave us a helping hand?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Monch, Monch!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Just where did she go...?!

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: Are you looking for me, Madame?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Do you really need to ask?!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: You're usually pretty quick on your feet. Why're you wandering about like you're going to the park, now of all times?! I told you we must be ready for this hunt... Whatever, how are preparations going?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: To tell you the truth, Monch, you're the most dependable warrior I have.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: It's all down to you whether I can bring honor to the Browntail clan and get back at that bitch Ratatos!

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: Madame, if I may speak my mind...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: If you have something to say, say it!

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: As I see it, if you truly wish to impress Matriarch Ratatos with such a fine performance that she sees you in a new light, I'm afraid you should set your eyes on more than just the hunt.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I'm aware of that... but what else could I do?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Ratatos always has everything thought out well in advance. It's like she's not giving me any chances. Hmph, I'll admit she's a little smarter than me.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: But I... I'm not useless either!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: That's why you have to make sure you do your job well, no matter what it takes, Monch!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: You and I will sap some of that stinking bitch's arrogance together! I will show her how amazing I can be!

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: I understand how you feel about the Browntails, Madame.

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: But in that case, you should really set your eyes on more than just the hunt.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Tell me, then. What else could we do?

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: If you trust my judgment—

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: What're you talking about? If I don't trust you, who else could I trust?

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: I appreciate your trust, Madame. So please leave this matter to me. I have a few ideas... but we need to be careful. It's not the right time to jump to conclusions.

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: As for you, Madame, to make sure everything goes well, please do not tell Sir Yucatan about this affair.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Not even Yucatan?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Right. He's always in the way, treating me like a little girl. He even tells on me to Ratatos. As if I don't know...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I'll leave everything to you, Monch! Don't disappoint me!

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: Of course. Please rest assured...

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: When all is said and done, I will make sure you will get your time in the limelight.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: 'The sound of the bell rings from Her purest soul. Those who love Her cast their heads down to listen, and Kjeragandr shines her countenance upon all Her faithful children.'

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: —Listen. The bells of the hour have chimed.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: You were almost late, Sir Enciodes.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I beg forgiveness.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: The path of enlightenment is always a treacherous one. This, too, must be one of Kjeragandr's trials for the Silverashes.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: You walked all the way from Turicum to Mount Karlan. It must have been an exhausting journey.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: However... I hope you will find your right path forward.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: With your blessings, Great Saintess, the path ahead is shrouded no more.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Even as we speak, I am making my way toward Kjeragandr's teachings.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: You have a fine way with words, Sir Enciodes.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You flatter me.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I am profoundly humbled to be welcomed by the Great Saintess herself.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: With the pomp and circumstance of your entrance, I wouldn't dare to give you the cold shoulder, Sir Enciodes.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Where can I find the Great Elder, if I may ask?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: The Great Elder is preparing for the ceremony. Such is why I'm here to receive you myself.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: For this Holy Hunt, I shall follow Kjeragandr's will and stand alongside you to bring this ceremony to a successful conclusion.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You mean... you will personally take to the hunting grounds?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Do you too think my decision is a rash one, Sir Enciodes?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Not in the slightest.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I'm simply overcome with emotion. It seems you have come to realize the gravity of your position as leader of the three clans. It's a fortunate thing for Kjerag.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: It's my responsibility.

steps.name: Servant
steps.text: Great Saintess, Sir Enciodes, the Holy Hunt will begin shortly. Please hurry.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: It's nearly time.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Please come with me, Sir Enciodes.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: After you, Great Saintess.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Sir Enciodes.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Whether your path is right or wrong, Kjerag has its own path to follow.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: No one can decide for all of Kjeragandr's children.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I feel the same way...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Our merits are not for others to judge. Now that things have come to this, there is no reason for me to back away. With my actions...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: —I did all that I could, nothing more.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: By Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I, as Saintess, hereby declare.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I shall lead Kjerag's finest warriors to find and lay waste to all the Tschäggättä hiding in the mountains, so that Kjerag may have peace.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: By Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I, Arctosz, as always, will lead my warriors of the house of Paleroche, following the Saintess in her quest to find all Tschäggättä hiding in the mountains.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: And to bring back the most magnificent prey.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: By Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I, Ratatos, as always, will lead my warriors of the house of Browntail, following the Saintess in her quest to hunt down all Tschäggättä hiding in the mountains.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: And to bring back the most exquisite prey.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: By Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I, Enciodes, as always, will lead my warriors of the house of Silverash, following the Saintess in her quest to suppress all Tschäggättä hiding in the mountains.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: And to bring back the most ferocious prey.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: May our faith reach Kjeragandr, and may prosperity reach Kjerag.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: May our faith reach Kjeragandr, and may prosperity reach Kjerag...

steps.name: Tri-Clan Leaders
steps.text: May our faith reach Kjeragandr, and may prosperity reach Kjerag.

steps.name: Everyone in Attendance
steps.text: —May our faith reach Kjeragandr, and may prosperity reach Kjerag!

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Everyone, please check your equipment.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Let the hunt begin!
